claims: The 2026 Masters weekend coverage is on Saturday, April 11, and Sunday, April 12.
2026 Masters weekend coverage begins at 12:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App.
CBS television coverage for the 2026 Masters weekend is from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Tee times for Saturday and Sunday of the 2026 Masters begin in the morning.
Featured groups for Saturday and Sunday of the 2026 Masters start around 8:55 a.m.
Live streaming for the 2026 Masters weekend is on Paramount+ and Masters.com from 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. ET.
TV coverage for the 2026 Masters weekend is on CBS from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET
